Strawberry Ice Hookah Labs 80K is a Nixodine product from Hookah Labs. Nixodine is a newer nicotine alternative, and these devices are listed in their own category so you can compare them with traditional nicotine salt options in one place.

Strawberry Ice Hookah Labs 80K is listed at $17.99 in our Nixodine range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Nixodine](/shop/nixodine/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name Icy / Menthol points to a crisp, chilled edge that keeps the profile fresh, with bright, juicy berry notes with a natural sweet-tart balance. Descriptions like this are a guide to the intended profile; your own experience will depend on your setup and preferences.

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Clear specifications:** strength and capacity are shown on this page and on the label.
- **Compact body:** easy to carry and simple to operate.

### Strength and size options
This listing offers more than one option — pack sizes Single Device, 5-Pack Bundle. Choose yours above the Add to Cart button and the price updates to match, then set the quantity you need. Your choice appears in your cart and on your order confirmation, so there is no guessing at fulfillment.

## Who it suits
Strawberry Ice Hookah Labs 80K suits adult users curious about Nixodine and anyone comparing it with standard nicotine salt devices.

## Using and caring for it
Use as directed on the packaging, take short puffs, keep the device upright and away from heat, and do not open or modify it. Dispose of used devices according to local rules for electronics and batteries, and keep them out of reach of children and pets.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
You can order Strawberry Ice Hookah Labs 80K online with Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency or gift cards. Pay with crypto or a supported gift card and you save 10% on your order total. Orders of $200 or more after discounts ship free; below that, shipping is a flat $15, and the minimum order is $100.

Orders are processed within 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse and ship with tracking by a regional carrier. Because these are vapor products, an adult aged 21 or older must sign for delivery under the PACT Act, so make sure someone of age can receive the parcel.

## Returns and support
Our returns window is 30 days from purchase. Unopened products in their original packaging qualify, refunds are issued through the same payment method that was used for the order, less a 15% restocking fee, and opened or used items cannot be accepted. Contact us first so we can send an RMA form. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
